physical_blocks.exact_text: Table 14.5.2.1.1  Summary of Hematology Results– Safety Analysis Set

Note: For hematology parameter, baseline of cycle 1 is defined as the last valid value on or prior to the first date of chemotherapy. The baseline of each cycle in cycle 2-4 is defined as
the last valid value on or within 3 days  prior to the first date of chemotherapy of each cycle.

Programming notes: 1. For hematology parameter, “Day 1 of cycle xx” is not as a analysis visit, its value is included in the baseline analysis of each cycle.
Visits not specified in the study flow chart will not be summarized in table.
2. Repeat for all hematology parameter: White blood cell count (10^9/L ), Neutrophil count (10^9/L ), Eosinophil count (10^9/L), Basophil count (10^9/L ) etc.
3. Please use "Baseline of cycle xx" for baseline of each cycle.
